scenarios: shell reject pre, then another approved action and same-session new user turn
shell reject post masks result, then another approved action and same-session new user turn

live_tests.limitations: Shell/MCP development runs preceded the final cancellation-edge rebuild; final packaged verification runs against the final bundle.

packaged_live_tests.installation: Fresh extracted ZIP; bundled single JS file without plugin node_modules
packaged_live_tests.continuation: All four rejection scenarios verified a separately approved next action and next user turn in the same session with the same server/plugin control identity.

observed: native session information and full available messages
raw MCP content/resource/structuredContent/_meta at post before masking
live_context.MCP_definitions: Direct MCP definitions are not exposed by V1 registry/tool.definition; definition_ids remain empty and match is unknown, rather than invented.

review.status: complete; no unresolved findings in this change
fixed: Refusal no longer latches session/tree or aborts adjacent calls.
All own builtin/MCP result fields are replaced in place before normal result release.
Cancellation during approval initialization cannot leave an orphan card.
An abort-ignoring tool late post after native error/idle is discarded without reopening approval; regression failed before fix and passed after.

regressions_verified: Concurrent approvals remain independently bound and cannot be replayed.
Same-session next action and user turn work after pre/post rejection without plugin reload.
UI failure and mutated approved values cancel only the affected checkpoint.
Actual page JS implements red per-action warning, bound continue/cancel buttons and tab capability recovery.
limits: Always-deny stub does not detect threats. Classifier unavailability intentionally fails open.
Live tests use builtin shell and direct local MCP; special slash/subtask and experimental background execution are outside this live suite.
V1 ordinary tool exceptions can bypass post. Previously emitted metadata, external side effects and truncation files cannot be retracted.

Special slash/subtask pre refusal may end the current turn; it installs no session latch. This path may copy attachments before post. Background completion messages bypass the original post checkpoint.
No OS sandbox, exact final provider payload or complete ordinary MCP definition catalog is provided.
Known startup failure remains: if initialization fails before hooks are returned, OpenCode may continue without sensor enforcement.
Observed journals and cancelled invocation records are not automatically restored or rotated; a cancelled invocation is retained until a late post or session deletion.

known_open_findings.summary: Plugin initialization failure may leave OpenCode without sensor hooks; unchanged and outside the requested per-action cancellation fix.
